reason: Provides slash commands that automate management of a DeepSeek Harness web service, SSH tunnel, console TUI, and one-shot questions; process control and SSH execution justify R2 risk.

summaries.zh: 通过斜杠命令管理 DeepSeek Harness 网页服务、SSH 隧道、控制台 TUI，并执行一次性问题查询。
summaries.en: Provides slash commands to manage a DeepSeek Harness web service, SSH tunnel, console TUI, and one-shot questions.

capabilities: Starts, stops, and restarts a local web service process
Creates and terminates an SSH local port-forwarding tunnel
Launches a configured console TUI command
Runs a one-shot headless question command with a timeout
